about-us:
About Us

Welcome to AR Fragrances - where luxury meets affordability, and every scent tells a story of elegance and economic empowerment.

Our Mission:

At AR Fragrances, our mission is clear: to bring you the essence of the world's finest designer fragrances at prices that won't break the bank. We believe that everyone deserves to indulge in the luxury of a signature scent without compromising on quality. Our commitment to affordability doesn't mean compromising on excellence – each fragrance we offer boasts a high oil concentration, ensuring a long-lasting impression that rivals the world's leading brands.

Elevating Local Industries:

Beyond the realm of exquisite scents, AR Fragrances is dedicated to contributing to the growth of our local industries and fostering economic development. We are proud to be a part of a movement that not only brings international fragrances to your doorstep but also supports local artisans and businesses. By choosing AR Fragrances, you're not just choosing a fragrance; you're choosing to be a part of the economic bloom in our community.

Why AR Fragrances?

- Affordable Luxury: Immerse yourself in the opulence of high-quality fragrances without the hefty price tag.

- Long-lasting Impressions: Our fragrances are meticulously crafted with a higher oil concentration, ensuring a lasting and memorable experience.

- Local Empowerment: With every purchase, you are contributing to the growth of local industries and playing a role in boosting our economy.

Join Us on this Fragrance Journey:

AR Fragrances invites you to embark on a fragrance journey where luxury, affordability, and local empowerment converge. Explore our extensive collection, discover scents that resonate with you, and become a part of our vision to redefine the fragrance experience. Thank you for choosing AR Fragrances – where every bottle tells a tale of sophistication and prosperity.

Contact Us

Contact form

Frequently Asked Questions

1.What are AR Fragrances?

AR Fragrances is a top perfume brand that offers a wide range of high-quality scents. We have perfumes for men, women, and unisex, inspired by famous designer fragrances.

2.Are AR Fragrances long-lasting?

Yes, our perfumes are made to last all day. The quality ingredients ensure the scent stays strong from morning to night.

3.What are some of the best perfumes from AR Fragrances?

Some of our top perfumes are:

For Men: MR BLUE, DIVINE, HEIST, OCEAN SHADES, ADDICTION

For Women: GLAM GIRL

Unisex: TAQWA, UNPLANNED PLANS, ROYAL CROWN

4.Do you offer sample sizes or testers?

Yes, we offer a Pack of 5 Testers (5ml) where you can choose your favorite scents to try before buying full-size bottles.

5.What are the benefits of buying fragrance bundles?

Our fragrance bundles give you a variety of top scents at a lower price. Bundles include multiple perfumes, providing great value and a chance to try different fragrances.

6.Are there any special deals or discounts available?

Yes, we often have special deals and discounts. For example, the Bundle of 4 Top Scents 30ML for both men and women and the Bundle of Top 4 OUD 50ML are available at reduced prices.

7.How should I apply AR Fragrances for the best results?

For the best results, apply the perfume to pulse points like your wrists, neck, and behind your ears. These areas help spread the scent better.

8.Are AR Fragrances cruelty -free?

Yes, we do not test our perfumes on animals. We are committed to ethical practices.

9.Can I return or exchange a fragrance if I don’t like it?

Yes, we have a return policy. If you are not happy with your purchase, you can return or exchange it. Check our website or contact customer service for details.

10.How can I contact AR Fragrances customer service?

You can contact us through our website’s contact form, email, or phone number. We are here to help with any questions or issues.

11.Do AR Fragrances offer international shipping?

Yes, we ship internationally. Shipping rates and times vary by location. Check our website for more information.

12.Are there any exclusive collections or limited edition fragrances?

Yes, we sometimes release exclusive collections and limited edition perfumes. Keep an eye on our website and social media for updates.

13.What makes AR Fragrances different from other perfume brands?

We offer high-quality, long lasting scents inspired by iconic designer perfumes at affordable prices, making luxury accessible to everyone.

14.Can I find AR Fragrances in physical stores?

We mainly sell online, but sometimes we have pop-up events or collaborations with stores. Check our website and social media for announcements.

15.How often do new fragrances get launched?

We regularly update our collection with new fragrances. Subscribe to our newsletter or follow us on social media for the latest news.

16.What ingredients are used in AR Fragrances?

We use high-quality ingredients sourced from around the world to create our perfumes. Each fragrance is crafted to ensure a unique and lasting scent experience.

17.How should I store my AR Fragrances perfume?

Store your perfume in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and heat. This helps maintain the fragrance quality and longevity.

18.Are AR Fragrances suitable for sensitive skin?

Our perfumes are designed to be gentle, but if you have sensitive skin, it's always best to do a patch test first or consult with a dermatologist.

19.Can I customize my own fragrance at AR Fragrances?

Currently, we do not offer customization options. However, our wide range of scents ensures there is something for everyone.

20.How can I find the right perfume for me?

You can start by exploring our sample sets, such as the Pack of 5 Testers (5ml). This allows you to try different scents and find the one that suits you best.

21.What payment methods are accepted by AR Fragrances?

We accept various payment methods including credit/debit cards, bank transfers, and popular online payment platforms. Check our website for specific options.

22.How long does delivery take?

Delivery times vary depending on your location. Generally, orders within Pakistan take 3-5 business days, while international orders may take longer. Check our shipping policy for more details.

23.Can I track my order?

Yes, once your order is shipped, you will receive a tracking number via email. You can use this number to track your order online.

24.Are there any loyalty programs or rewards?

We occasionally offer promotions and rewards for our loyal customers. Sign up for our newsletter to stay updated on the latest offers and deals.

25.How can I leave a review for a product?

You can leave a review on our website by visiting the product page and submitting your feedback. We appreciate your reviews as they help other customers make informed decisions.

Refund Policy

At , customer satisfaction is our top priority. We’ve designed a hassle-free Exchange & Return Policy to ensure a seamless shopping experience.

ELIGIBILITY

  • Articles purchased online or in-store are eligible for exchange or return within 7 days of delivery.
  • Items must be unused
  • Items must be present in their original packaging.
  • A valid proof of purchase—either the original receipt or order confirmation email is required to process exchanges and returns.
  • Sale or discounted items are not eligible for exchange or return.

You will be required to share proof if you have received an article that is defected, in wrong size, or is incorrect.

EXCHANGES

ONLINE EXCHANGE POLICY

  • An exchange request can be initiated via Inbox at whatsApp +923330499831 within 7 days of order delivery.
  • Proof of purchase— the order confirmation email and order number must be provided.
  • Exchanges are subject to verification of product condition and eligibility & must be unused, unaltered and unwashed with all tags intact.
  • Customer will have to send the items in this address (Plot #2 hazarat abu bakr siddique RA Road, saggiyan, lahore  Phone# 03213254032)
  • Once the items are received and verified, the requested items will be shipped.
  • The exchange process takes approximately 7–10 working days.
  • If the requested item is out of stock, customers will be given option to select from another available article, else the amount will be refunded.

Sale/discounted items are not eligible for exchange.

RETURNS

ONLINE RETURN POLICY

  • Returns are only accepted if the item delivered was incorrect (wrong size/wrong product) or if the item was defective/damaged at the time of delivery.
    • An exchange request can be initiated via Inbox at whatsApp +923330499831 within 7 days of order delivery
  • Proof of purchase— the order confirmation email and order number must be provided.
  • Reason for return and proof of defect/damage must be provided.
  • The product must unused, unwashed, and unaltered with all tags intact.
  • Customer has to send back the article to the address (Plot #2 hazarat abu bakr siddique RA Road, saggiyan, lahore  Phone# 03213254032)
  • Once the product is received and verified, amount will be refunded to the customer bank account, Please note (Courier Delivery charges+4% COD Tax ) will be deducted on COD parcels as we already have it to Courier company.
  • The return process takes approximately 7–10 working days.

shipping-policy:
Shipping Policy

Processing and Delivery:

At AR Fragrances, we understand the excitement of receiving your favorite scents promptly. Our dedicated team strives to process and dispatch orders swiftly, ensuring you experience the joy of your chosen fragrances as soon as possible.

Processing Time: Orders are typically processed within 1-2 business days after confirmation of payment.

Delivery Time: Our standard delivery time is estimated between 3-5 working days. We aim to get your cherished fragrances to your doorstep promptly, allowing you to indulge in the luxury of our scents without unnecessary delays.

Delays and Special Circumstances:

While we make every effort to adhere to our standard delivery timelines, unforeseen circumstances such as road blockages or public holidays may impact delivery schedules. In such cases, we appreciate your understanding as it may take a bit longer to receive your order.

Shipping Partners:

AR Fragrances partners with reliable and reputable courier services to ensure the safe and timely delivery of your packages. Once your order is dispatched, you will receive a tracking number, allowing you to monitor the journey of your fragrances until they arrive at your doorstep.

International Shipping:

Currently, AR Fragrances operates within Pakistan. For international orders, please contact our customer service for personalized assistance regarding shipping options, costs, and delivery times.

Order Tracking:

Track the journey of your fragrances in real-time! Once your order is dispatched, we will provide you with a tracking number via email. You can use this number to monitor the status of your delivery.

AR Fragrances appreciates your trust in our brand, and we are committed to providing you with a seamless and delightful fragrance shopping experience. Thank you for choosing AR Fragrances!
